newsitem.title: CHINA: China police clear Tiananmen Square.
newsitem.headline: China police clear Tiananmen Square.

text.p: Unarmed Chinese police accompanied by paramilitary personnel cleared Beijing's vast Tiananmen Square of tens of thousands of sightseers on Monday ahead of a ceremony to mark Hong Kong's handover to China.
Hundreds of police advanced in tight-knit ranks on the crowd, with paramilitary People's Armed Police behind them, pushing reluctant and curious onlookers to the sides of the square.

Behind the police were dozens of city sanitary workers, who swept the square clean of the debris left by the hundreds of thousands of city residents and tourists from all over China who have flocked to the square in recent days to see decorations for the handover celebration.

Officials had announced in advance the clearing of the square would take place shortly after 3.00 p.m. (0700 GMT) and have advised Beijing's 11 million residents who are not among the 100,000 invited guests to stay at home and watch television.
The square was due to reopen to the public on Tuesday morning after the ceremonies end with the dawn raising in the square of China's national flag.
China will retake Hong Kong at midnight (1600 GMT) on Monday after 156 years of British colonial rule.
